contentPattern.structure: side-by-side image + copy (heading + short paragraph + call-to-action link[s])

suitableFor: mid-page promotional callout banners with an illustration beside a heading, short text and a CTA
coloured 'sub-hero' promo strips (e.g. scam warning, app download) with image on one side and copy + link(s) on the other
single highlight promos that are NOT full-bleed photo backgrounds
notSuitableFor: full-bleed photo hero at the very top of the page (use hero-promo)
dark full-width award/brand banners with no CTA (use hero-award)
repeating grids of items (use cards / cards-teaser)

usage.notes: Reused twice on the homepage for the same 'sub-hero-banner' pattern: (Section 4) scam-warning callout on a light-blue box with a single 'Find Out More' CTA; (Section 9) 'Download the Admiral app' promo on a blue banner with two app-store badge links. Reused again on the Admiral magazine article (10-ways-to-make-your-car-last-longer): end-of-article 'Great car insurance options for the whole family' mini sub-hero promo - illustrated car image beside heading + single green 'Find out more' CTA on a blue band. Image-beside-text with copy + CTA(s), coloured accent background (not a full-bleed photo).
